description: This file defines a mock class 'ControlModuleServiceFactoryMock' for unit testing, which implements the 'IControlModuleServiceFactory' interface. It uses Google Mock to mock the 'create' method that returns a shared pointer to 'IControlModuleService' and takes references to 'IPlaybackService' and 'IControlService' as parameters.

classes.name: ControlModuleServiceFactoryMock
classes.description: Mock class for 'IControlModuleServiceFactory' used in testing, providing a mocked 'create' method.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Mocked method that creates and returns a shared pointer to 'IControlModuleService' given references to 'IPlaybackService' and 'IControlService'.
